name: QuickSnipe
browserRequirements: Google Chrome 116 or higher, Chromium, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Opera
description: All-in-one Google Chrome Sidepanel Extension for multi-channel e-commerce resellers. Includes 1-click cross-listing across Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari & Depop with batch ZIP photo downloads, USPS 16 oz shipping ounce trap radar, local sourcing flip CRM with IRS Schedule C tax CSV export, buyer offer negotiator, and multimodal photo-to-listing vision AI with 3-second phone-to-PC QR sync.

competitorAlternatives.name: Vendoo
competitorAlternatives.comparison: QuickSnipe replaces Vendoo's $30-$150/mo subscription with a native in-browser Chrome extension, generous free daily tier, and 1-time lifetime purchase option.

competitorAlternatives.name: List Perfectly
competitorAlternatives.comparison: QuickSnipe operates directly inside Chrome sidepanel with 1-click photo ZIP downloads and floating QuickBar HUD, keeping all data private in local storage with zero cloud lock-in.

competitorAlternatives.name: Crosslist
competitorAlternatives.comparison: QuickSnipe provides built-in shipping cliff radar, buyer offer negotiation, and local CRM alongside cross-listing without monthly subscription barriers.

coreModules.name: 1-Click Omnichannel Cross-Lister
coreModules.description: Cross-lists product data across Etsy, eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, and Depop with 1-click batch ZIP photo extraction and floating QuickBar form autofill HUD.

coreModules.name: USPS 16 oz Ground Advantage Shipping Trap Radar
coreModules.description: Alerts sellers at the 15.9 oz threshold before buying postage to prevent overpaying $3.60 to $6.00+ when packages accidentally cross the 16.0 oz cliff into 1-2 lb Priority rates.

coreModules.name: Local-First Sourcing & Flip Tracker CRM
coreModules.description: Tracks buy cost (COGS), purchase venue, sold date, net take-home profit, and ROI% locally in browser with 1-click CSV export ready for IRS Form 1040 Schedule C.

coreModules.name: Buyer Offer Negotiator & Counteroffer Matrix
coreModules.description: Audits buyer offers on eBay, Poshmark, Mercari, and Depop, calculating net profit after platform cuts and recommending 3 sweet-spot counteroffers.

coreModules.name: Multimodal Photo-to-Listing Vision AI
coreModules.description: Analyzes product photos for brand, care tags, materials, and condition to draft multi-platform titles, 13 compliant tags, bulleted item specifics, and price appraisals.

coreModules.name: QuickSnipe Snap: Phone-to-PC Mobile WebRTC Sync
coreModules.description: Beams photos from smartphone cameras directly into desktop Chrome in under 3 seconds via dynamic QR code pairing with zero mobile app installs.

coreModules.name: Barcode & UPC Scanner
coreModules.description: Scans retail UPC, EAN, and ISBN barcodes on books, media, toys, and packaged goods via webcam or image upload.

coreModules.name: Marketplace Fee & Margin Simulator
coreModules.description: Calculates platform transaction fees, payment processing, breakeven thresholds, and net margins across 9 major platforms.

freeTier.description: Free daily snipes, cross-listing, and calculations forever.

proMonthly.description: Unlimited cross-listing, high-volume snipes, and flip CRM.

proAnnual.description: All Pro features billed yearly (saves 48% vs monthly).

proLifetime.description: Perpetual lifetime license for all current and future Pro features.
